# Synthetic Phase 4B parser fixtures

- `aitranss_self_energy_file_format_error.out` contains only the minimal grammar needed to classify the documented reader-format failure.
- `self_energy_reader_compatible_minimal.in` exercises the supported seven-token row grammar with synthetic coordinates.
- `tcontrol.attempt01` uses synthetic numerical values while preserving the atom-count and surface-index invariants required by the junction-selection tests.

These files are offline parser fixtures and are not evidence of an external scientific run.
